one_liner: Unified spend platform with global corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel, and bill pay.
auth_notes: OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration is recommended, alongside traditional API tokens generated by admins.
access_notes: Sign up on Brex developer portal and enable Developer API access in settings.
api_notes: REST API covering Accounting, Budgets, Expenses, Fields, Onboarding, Payments, Team, Transactions, Travel, and Webhooks.
blocker_notes: Public documentation, self-serve developer access, and an official remote MCP server are available.

auth.quote: OAuth is the recommended path and the less alarming one. Any employee can authorize it, and the tools they get are scoped to what their own Brex role already allows

access.quote: Using the Brex API, you can power your internal tools and create custom workflows.

api.quote: Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification and use standard HTTP response codes and verbs.

mcp.quote: Yes — Brex ships an official MCP server, and it’s hosted by Brex. The endpoint is https://api.brex.com/mcp

verdict.quote: Check out our quickstart guide to get up and running making your first Brex API call in just a few minutes.
